About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.  

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Journey Marketing’s goal is to turn every member touchpoint, from first website or app visit, into long-term loyalty and lasting relationships. It uses a personalized, data-driven engine that activates, engages, monetizes, and retains members at scale. Journey Enablement sits within Journey Marketing and owns Life360's MarTech strategy end to end, from data infrastructure and unified member identity to AI-powered decisioning and 1:1 personalization across in-app, web, email, SMS, and push.

About the Job

This is a senior team leadership role at the intersection of traditional MarTech platform experience and the emerging discipline of AI orchestration and intelligent decisioning. You will manage the tools, data infrastructure, and technical capabilities that let Journey Marketing reach the right member with the right message at the right moment, programmatically, across every surface, without manual re-entry at every step. You will build the stack from a position of honest assessment: evaluating what exists, identifying what’s missing, and making clear build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls against a strategic roadmap.

You will act as a core strategic partner to the Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering, and Ads teams. You will represent Journey Marketing’s requirements to Life360’s company-wide Machine Learning platforms and decisioning engines, and own the infrastructure decisions that define how this function operates and evolves over time.

In your first year, you'll take our existing decisioning vendor to full use across lifecycle and member journeys while partnering with our ML team on the in-house decisioning platform that will run most of our campaigns by the end of 2027.

The US-based salary range for this position is $156,000 to $231,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead the four-person MarTech team through your direct report, the Senior Manager, MarTech, who manages the other three team members. You'll report to the VP, Journey Marketing.
  • Shape how the team evolves, defining roles, skills, and hiring priorities as the function moves toward AI-powered decisioning and orchestration.
  • Build the team's fluency in AI decisioning tools so they can design and run journeys that can't be built manually today.

MarTech Stack Evolution

  • Lead the holistic MarTech strategy: evaluate vendor landscapes, identify capability gaps against the Journey Marketing roadmap, and advocate for principled build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations, and  drive decisions through the right forums.
  • Own a scope that includes CRM, decisioning platforms, CDP, and the AI/ML layer that ties it together.

1:1 Personalization at Scale

  • Lead the strategy and infrastructure roadmap for true 1:1 decisioning across multiple surfaces: choose the right platforms, navigate the data requirements, and guide a team through the operational complexity.

CDP & Data Infrastructure

  • Lead unified member identity strategy and CDP evaluation and ownership.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define data modeling requirements for personalization, setting the vision for the multi-dimensional member context architecture and working through shared data teams to build and maintain it.

AI-Powered Decisioning

  • Define and advocate for the right long-term decision architecture: what to buy, what to build internally, and how external tools should interact with Life360’s own ML capabilities, working through shared ML and engineering platforms.

Campaign Execution Evolution

  • Formalize AI-assisted campaign workflows: development, AI-assisted canvas build, and QA automation.
  • Define what gets automated and what requires human judgment, and build the confidence and governance to keep expanding automation across Journey Marketing.

What We’re Looking For

Strategic MarTech Leadership

  • Prior experience leading a MarTech function: evaluated vendor landscapes, mapped capability gaps against a strategic roadmap, and built or rebuilt a stack from first principles.
  • Designed and operated a channel-agnostic, real-time personalization engine at scale across multiple surfaces, navigating the data requirements, platform tradeoffs, and organizational complexity.

MarTech & Marketing Operations

  • 12+ years building customer journeys across lifecycle marketing (LCM), app, and web.
  • At least 5 years in a senior leadership role owning a team and a stack in MarTech, Marketing Operations, or Lifecycle Marketing.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform, including canvas architecture, triggered journeys, advanced segmentation, Liquid logic, and data feed management.
  • Proven track record of evaluating and selecting MarTech vendors: building the business case, running the RFP, and executing the transition with discipline.
  • Experience building multi-channel lifecycle programs across email, push, SMS, and in-app at consumer scale (mobile app or subscription product experience strongly preferred).
  • Experience with web personalization tools, so the customer journey is holistic across multiple surfaces

Data & Infrastructure

  • Experience with or ownership of a CDP (e.g., Segment, mParticle, Tealium, Adobe, Hightouch, Salesforce Data Cloud) and a working understanding of unified member identity, data modeling for personalization, and first-party data strategy.
  • Ability to translate marketing requirements into data and engineering requirements, and vice versa; comfortable working directly with data science, ML engineering, and product engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with data warehouse and pipeline tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks); SQL proficiency expected, engineering depth not required.
  • Experience with centralized ML platforms, shared feature stores, batch inference pipelines, and scoring conventions.

AI, ML & Personalization

  • Experience operationalizing ML model outputs (propensity scores, churn risk, recommendations) into campaign tools and automated journeys, coordinating across data science and engineering to move from inference to execution.
  • Experience with AI-powered decisioning platforms (e.g., Braze AI, Auxia, Movable Ink, Dynamic Yield) and the ability to evaluate them against an internal ML capability.
  • Understanding of contextual bandits, A/B and multivariate testing frameworks, and experimentation best practices; experience working alongside a data science or experimentation team.
  • Experience with AI decisioning tests and AI-assisted workflows, a strong command of agentic marketing, and a track record of build vs. buy vs. partner decisions you can defend.

Leadership & Cross-Functional

  • Track record of building and developing strong teams.
  • Ability to hold the strategic layer (stack decisions, roadmap, vendor evaluation) while managing day-to-day delivery.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts: able to build durable working relationships with Product, Data, Engineering, Creative, Ads, and eCommerce teams, and navigate shared infrastructure priorities without losing momentum on your own roadmap.
  • Program management instincts sufficient to coordinate a team serving multiple business pillars simultaneously.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees).
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.
